### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**3** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **215** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **155** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **155**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **100** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.

Coarse fallback — **136** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 225197cdbaff647a8b12e52bcb9d7bbb5b07ed08` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `d2ab4e4a79caa80823a4c6c75ed530e11f5f46a2` — the merge of head `eac52ecb7b94d18cf0a16d52f43132fc3bf19ed3` into base `225197cdbaff647a8b12e52bcb9d7bbb5b07ed08`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin d2ab4e4a79caa80823a4c6c75ed530e11f5f46a2 && git checkout d2ab4e4a79caa80823a4c6c75ed530e11f5f46a2
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 225197cdbaff647a8b12e52bcb9d7bbb5b07ed08 eac52ecb7b94d18cf0a16d52f43132fc3bf19ed3 && git checkout -B drift-repro 225197cdbaff647a8b12e52bcb9d7bbb5b07ed08 && git merge --no-ff eac52ecb7b94d18cf0a16d52f43132fc3bf19ed3

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 225197cdbaff647a8b12e52bcb9d7bbb5b07ed08
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## Contract review

**Head sha reviewed:** `eac52ecb7b94d18cf0a16d52f43132fc3bf19ed3` — read from the PR API, from `git fetch` (`FETCH_HEAD` identical), and re-read via `git ls-remote` at 2026-09-13T08:29:56Z: unchanged for the whole review. Merge-base with `origin/main` is `bd25e897d`; `origin/main` advanced to `2c87a48f` while I worked and the three-dot diff against it is the same 7 files / +24 −6.

Everything below is judged from the diff and from measurements on a worktree at that head (`gen:schema`, `gen:docs`, full `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` with DTS, `BUILD_EXIT=0`, `check-dts-emitted 34/34`), never from the PR body.

### ① derived judgments

**Accept set** — enumeration is empty, and that emptiness is measured, not assumed:

- `packages/spec/src/kernel/plugin-loading.zod.ts:104` `durationMs` — validator chain `z.number().int().min(0).optional()` byte-identical before/after; only `.describe('Duration in milliseconds')` appended. Parse probe (valid / negative / non-integer / absent / string) gives identical outcomes at merge-base and head. PR says "no accept/reject outcome moves": **right**.
- `packages/spec/src/system/app-install.zod.ts:146` `durationMs` — describe text only; 3 fixtures identical before/after. **Right.**
- `packages/spec/src/system/deploy-bundle.zod.ts:129` `estimatedDurationMs` — describe text only; 3 fixtures identical before/after. **Right.**
- Zero new keys / enum members / union arms / exports / registrations. `check-widening-tells --declaration no` on the real diff: exit 0, 3 files judged, no tell. **Lit control on the same subject:** a synthetic one-key addition to the same `z.object` at `plugin-loading.zod.ts:105` fires T1, exit 4; self-test 269 cases pass. So the zero is a reading.
- Mechanism: zod 4.4.3 `describe()` is `clone()` + `globalRegistry.add(cl, { description })` (`zod/v4/classic/schemas.js:166-170`) — no check is attached.

**Public surface** — what actually changes in published artefacts (`files[]` = `dist`, `json-schema`, `src/**/*.zod.ts`, …):

- `json-schema/kernel/PluginLoadingEvent.json` `properties.durationMs` **gains a `"description"` annotation key** (base: `{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":…}`; head: `"description":"Duration in milliseconds"` at line 33). This is the one place a new key appears on a published artefact. Judgment: it is a JSON-Schema annotation keyword on the schema *document*, not a key on the *payload* the schema accepts — no author may write anything new (probe above), and the mechanical floor's 「已发布载荷上的新键」 and T1's own definition ("the accept set gains a spelling an author may now write") are about payload keys. **Not the affirmative.** The PR's "no key moves" is right about payload keys but does not name this annotation; recorded here so the next reader does not have to rediscover it.
- `json-schema/system/AppInstallResult.json`, `system/MigrationPlan.json` — existing `description` text changes. Old strings base 2/2 → head 0/0; new strings 2/2. **Right.**
- `dist/**` esm/cjs bundles carry the new literals (24 occ / 12 files, 8/4, 8/4); `.d.ts` files carry 0. **Right** (PR's numbers reproduce exactly).
- `content/docs/references/{kernel/plugin-loading:46, system/app-install:89, system/deploy-bundle:192}.mdx` — regenerated rows. `gen:docs` at head: 222 files, porcelain empty ⇒ the committed pages are **byte-identical to the generator's output**; `check:docs` exit 0. Not hand-edited. **Right.**
- Ratchets: `api-surface/system.json:425-427` lists export names only (`MigrationPlan (type)` …); `check:api-surface` against my built dist: "unchanged ✓". `authorable-surface.base.json:6250` is the bare token `system/MigrationPlan:estimatedDurationMs` (the file has exactly one `"description"` key — its own header). `json-schema.manifest/kernel.json:103` is a schema-name list, no hashes. `gen:schema` at head moved no tracked file (and it does repair those projections when behind, so the empty porcelain is lit). **Correctly unmoved** — by construction these ratchets cannot see describe text, so their green is not evidence for this change; the evidence is the before/after above.
- Exported symbols: none added or removed.
- `.changeset/17786-duration-describe-units.md`: `@objectstack/spec: patch`.

### ② semver grading

Criterion 「改动前过校验的输入改动后同判 ⇒ 文本面」 tested directly: 11 parse-outcome lines identical between merge-base and head; only the three `description` readings differ (`null`→`Duration in milliseconds`, `Installation duration`→`…in milliseconds`, `Estimated execution time`→`…in milliseconds`). Text face ⇒ `patch` (文本面的 changeset 恒 patch). Declared level `patch`, declaration `Clause-②: no` on both carriers (PR body; card comment `5651943470`), `check-clause2-carriers --pair 17953` exit 0. **Consistent.**

### ③ boundary flags

1. `packages/spec/scripts/check-duration-unit-keys.ts` + self-test untouched by design — `git diff --name-only … -- packages/spec/scripts/` = 0 paths. **Accept.**
2. `content/docs/releases/` untouched — 0 paths. **Accept.**
3. Regenerated `content/docs/references/**` outside the dispatched file surface — required by AGENTS.md:700 (`.describe()` ⇒ `check:docs` ⇒ `gen:schema && gen:docs`) and lane rule 产物随源走; byte-identical generator output. **Accept** (the dispatch's surface list was incomplete, not the PR).
4. "Measured refinement" (`dist/` does not discriminate describe from JSDoc; `json-schema/` decides) — **re-measured on my own build, confirmed exactly:** JSDoc-only `Objects created or updated` dist 4 / json-schema 0; `//` comment `Plugin loaded at runtime` dist 4 / json-schema 0; positive control `Objects created/updated` 4 / 2; negative `no exemption by blindness` 0 / 0; dark 0 / 0. One precision: the comment text lives in the esm/cjs bundles themselves (`kernel/index.mjs:22346` bare `//`, `:22361` JSDoc, `:22363` describe literal), not in declarations (0 in `.d.ts`) — which contradicts `tsup.config.ts`'s own header claim that non-annotation comments are dropped from bundles. Stale comment in the config, not a defect of this PR. **Accept**, note for the config owner.
5. `noted, not filed` — JSDoc-only members of `PluginLoadingEvent` rendering empty cells (visible at `plugin-loading.mdx:43-48`) — outside this card's population. **Accept**; whether to file is the triage seat's call.
6. Consumer sweep — cross-package tests reading references are exactly the two named (`packages/lint/src/validate-flow-trigger-readiness.test.ts:300`, `packages/rest/src/analytics-fault-user-message.test.ts:97`). The sentence "no tracked file outside … carries any of the three strings" is wrong on the letter for `Duration in milliseconds` (`packages/observability/src/perf-timing.ts:43,60`, an unrelated JSDoc using the same generic phrase) and right in substance (not a consumer). **Correct, no action.**
7. Targeted suites (`deploy-bundle`, `app-install`, `plugin-loading`): 3 files / 40 tests pass at head — matches the PR. All 35 CI check runs green or skipped at this head; that is not what carries the verdict.

**Implemented-by:** `claude/issue-17786-duration-describe-units`
**Reviewed-by:** `session_015c5G6TmpMKgnusmTpD7Ntt`
(As the seat already recorded on #15939: the authoring subagent inherited this same session id — 席内至档, not an independent second seat.)

**PASS** — the diff moves describe prose only: every parse outcome is identical before and after, no payload key / export / member / registration is added (lit-controlled), the regenerated pages are the generator's byte-identical output, and `Clause-②: no` / `patch` is what the diff actually does.

### Provenance and tier verification — the seat's own record, not the reviewer's

Adopted **verbatim** by the epic PM seat for #15939, `session_015c5G6TmpMKgnusmTpD7Ntt`, 2026-09-13T08:47Z. The downgrade fuse permits exactly two acts on a review — adopt verbatim or void entirely — and ⛔ never rewriting, abridging or polishing it. This is the former.

- **Served tier, read from the harness-stamped transcript, ⛔ not from any self-report:** `152` messages stamped `"model":"claude-fable-5-1"`, **zero other values**. `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` is `claude-fable-5-1` (`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs:10507`) — exact match, as that constant's docblock requires (EXACT, never a family or prefix floor).
- **Discriminating control:** the authoring round's transcript over the same grep reads `189 × "model":"claude-opus-5"`. The instrument distinguishes the two, so the fable reading is a reading and not an artefact of the grep.
- **Independence, stated honestly:** the reviewer ran in a context-isolated seat fed only the card, the standing rulings and the PR itself — ⛔ never the dispatch order and ⛔ never this seat's own conclusions. It nevertheless inherits this session id, so this is 席内至档, ⛔ not an independent second seat. Recorded rather than glossed.
- ⛔ No `needs:contract-review` carrier was ever hung on this PR, and that is deliberate: the label is hung with a `Clause-②: yes` claim (`SKILL.md:645`), and `check-changeset-no-major` reads it as a clause-② affirmative that overrides the body line — which would force this genuinely non-widening change to `minor`. The authoring round declined to attach it for exactly that reason and was right to.

⚠️ One item the review raises is **not** this PR's and is recorded so it is not lost: `tsup.config.ts`'s header claims non-annotation comments are dropped from the bundles, and the measurement above shows a bare `//` comment reaching `kernel/index.mjs:22346`. Carrier: the config's owner. No PR is queued on that file today, so it is an observation without a carrier rather than a card.
